summary: Nylon-string guitar: bossa nova, latin, lofi

body: Bossa nova comping (chords on the syncopated pattern), lofi samples. A finer one: Spanish classical guitar/Classical guitar.

Register: MIDI 40-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Nylon Guitar, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Nylon Guitar") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
